name: phd-cannot-evaluate-survives-a-passed-deadline
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: a blank rules-sheet cell is not a missed deadline. This student passed all three core areas and the research qualifier and has the nine ND regular credits — the ONLY thing unresolved is that `category_courses_required` is missing from the Parameters tab, so §4.4.2 cannot be evaluated. Both deadline overrides used to bulldoze that into "unmet — Overdue, talk to the DGS" (and, on the time-limit row, into an alarming "the 8-year limit passed" forfeiture message for a student who had in fact finished). CLAUDE.md: a missing parameter renders "cannot evaluate", never a default.

detailIncludes: cannot be evaluated until the rules sheet is complete
